description: Expander for PEQ14 — an envelope follower output per band

params.text: Smooths the followers, 0 to 100%; higher settings slow how quickly an output tracks a change in band level
Cuts the follower outputs by as much as -36dB counter-clockwise of centre, and boosts them by as much as +12dB clockwise

inputs.text: 0-10V scaling the DAMP setting, so 0V leaves the followers at their quickest

outputs.text: A voltage tracking the level of that band's output on the PEQ14

notes: goes immediately to the right of its PEQ14
